description:
About the Role

The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Hopper's partners, some of the world's largest banks, airlines and travel companies, to bring our AI into their business end to end: getting the data, building and tuning the models, and taking them to production. You will lead data and modelling on site as part of a small forward-deployed team, acting as the bridge between partners and Research. What makes the role distinctive is that the data that matters lives inside partners' own systems, so you make it usable, securely, and turn each deployment into reusable tooling that makes the next partner faster.


What would your day-to-day look like

  • Work on site with partner teams to connect to their systems, including on-premise and legacy platforms, and build secure, reliable data feeds.

  • Map messy, inconsistent commercial data from many sources into one clean model.

  • Build and run pipelines for large historical and near-real-time datasets, with monitoring and data quality checks.

  • Meet partners' security, privacy and IT review requirements, taking only the data the product needs.

  • Design, train and evaluate production ML models for a high-volume commercial use case, choosing the right approach and being clear about the trade-offs.

  • Build the evaluation and measurement that show whether the models are good enough, and where they aren't.

  • Build low-latency, high-throughput services that serve the models in production.

  • Design how the system decides what to answer and how, and how it improves from real usage.

  • Own reliability, cost and performance once the system is live.

  • Partner directly with technology and business teams, from first conversations to go-live.

  • Collaborate with Research and Product, feeding back what you learn in the field.

  • Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster.

An ideal candidate has

  • 5+ years building and shipping production ML systems end to end, covering data, modelling, serving and monitoring, which you will apply to a high-volume commercial use case from day one.

  • Strong data engineering experience, having built and kept running pipelines over large, messy datasets, which you will use to turn partner data into one clean model.

  • Experience integrating with systems you don't control, such as enterprise, on-premise or legacy platforms, and working through a customer's security and IT review, so you can get partner data flowing securely.

  • Experience building and running services that handle thousands of requests per second at sub-second response times, which you will use to serve models in production.

  • Travel industry experience (airlines, hotels, OTAs, metasearch or travel technology) working with availability, rates, schedules and inventory, and the systems behind them such as GDS, NDC and airline and hotel reservation systems, so you can read partner data quickly and spot what matters.

  • Sound judgment on modelling trade-offs and the ability to explain them to non-technical partners, which you will use to guide partner teams through decisions from first conversations to go-live.

  • At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews, so you are ready to lead data and modelling on site.

  • Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partner teams.

  • Bonus: experience in both airline and hotel data, or in another high-volume marketplace (e-commerce, ad tech, fintech) as well as travel, to bring patterns from other verticals to each deployment.

  • Bonus: forecasting, estimation or recommendation models in production, and experience working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer.

  • Bonus: forward-deployed, solutions or integration engineering experience at an enterprise software or data company, or an advanced degree in computer science, statistics or a related field.


Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

  • 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees

  • Access to Disability & Life insurance

  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)

  • DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan


About Hopper

At Hopper, we’re building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we’re doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we’re continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand’s cardholders, and we’ve since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That’s our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we’re the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What that looks like in practice:

  • Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.

  • Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.

  • HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.

  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that’s a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!

#LI-Remote

While this role utilizes automated systems to assess candidate suitability, every actionable decision is made by a human member of our team. Under local regulations, you have the right to understand the principal factors used in this assessment, request a correction of your data, or request a human review of any automated decision. To exercise these rights, please contact recruiting@hopper.com
